name: Temporal Durable Workflow Substrate
mechanism: Runs deterministic workflows and retryable activities on a durable orchestration service so long waits and process failures can resume from persisted history.
use_when: Agent work spans process restarts, timers, human waits or distributed workers
A separate durable substrate is justified by recovery-time and reliability objectives
avoid_when: A short in-process task can safely restart from the beginning
The team expects workflow durability to provide exactly-once external effects automatically
expected_effects: Durable progress across worker and process failure
Explicit workflow history, timers, retries and operator visibility
failure_modes: Operational complexity exceeds the workload reliability benefit
required_evals: recovery time objective and operational load
